config.script:
msg = "Are you sure you want to delete the selected Procedures/categories?"
	system.perspective.openPopup("UserConfirmPopup", "kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm",  {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteProcedures'}, title='Delete Procedures', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True, draggable=True)
#	self.view.getChild("root").deleteProcedures()
	
	return

exportData = self.view.getChild("root").exportProcedures()
	
	label = exportData.get('label')
	timeNow = system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
	fileName = '{} ({}).json'.format(label, timeNow)
	
	data = exportData.get('data')
	if not data:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'No procedures selected to export'})
		return
	
	document = system.util.jsonEncode({'exportType': 'procedureData', 'data': system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))})
	system.perspective.download(fileName, document)
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Procedures exported'})
	return

onChange.script:
data = self.props.params.data or None
	
	if data is None: return
	self.props.params.data = None
	
	data = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(data))
	
	self.saveImport(data)
	
	return

customMethods.name: saveImport
customMethods.script:
if data is None: return
	
	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	if userId is None: return
	
	result = self.view.getChild("root").importProcedures(data, int(userId))
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.procedures.data")
	system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast' if result['passed'] else 'showFailerToast', '\n - '.join([result['message']] + result['errorLog']))
	
	return

updateProcedureParent
customMethods.script:
newParentId = droppedItem['procedureCategoryId']
	
	if draggedItem['procedureId'] is not None: # means we've dragged a procedure as opposed to a procedure category
		system.kanoa.cmms.updateProcedureField(draggedItem['procedureId'], 'procedureCategoryId', newParentId, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': 'procedure: %s has been moved to a procedure category: %s'%(draggedItem['procedureName'], droppedItem['procedureCategoryName'])})
	else: # means we've dragged a procedure category as opposed to a procedure
		procedureCategoryInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedureCategory({'procedureCategoryId': draggedItem['procedureCategoryId']}))[0]
		procedureCategoryInfo['parentId'] = newParentId
		system.kanoa.cmms.updateProcedureCategory(procedureCategoryInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', payload={'message': 'procedure category: %s has been moved under procedure category: %s'%(draggedItem['procedureCategoryName'], droppedItem['procedureCategoryName'])})
	
	return

customMethods.name: exportProcedures
customMethods.script:
selection = self.view.custom.procedures.selection
	procedureIdSet = set(selection.procedureIds)
	categoryPaths = selection.procedureCategoryPaths
	
	if len(categoryPaths) > 0:
		# a category is selected - pull in every procedure nested under it (recursively)
		allProcedures = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedures({}))
		for procedure in allProcedures:
			procedurePath = procedure['procedureCategoryPath']
			if procedurePath is None: continue
			for categoryPath in categoryPaths:
				if procedurePath == categoryPath or procedurePath.startswith(categoryPath + '\\'):
					procedureIdSet.add(procedure['procedureId'])
					break
	
	records = []
	for procedureId in procedureIdSet:
		procedure = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedures({'procedureId': procedureId}), 0)
		if procedure is None or procedure['procedureId'] is None: continue
		
		steps = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedureSteps({'procedureId': procedureId}))
		for step in steps:
			step['checks'] = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getProcedureStepChecks({'procedureStepId': step['procedureStepId']}))
		
		records.append({'procedure': procedure, 'steps': steps})
	
	if len(records) == 0: label = 'No Data'
	elif len(records) == 1: label = records[0]['procedure']['procedureName']
	elif len(records) <= 3: label = ', '.join([x['procedure']['procedureName'] for x in records])
	else: label = '%s et al.'%records[0]['procedure']['procedureName']
	
	# dataType/engUnit reference-table dumps, so importProcedures() can resolve
	# stepConfig/checkConfig's embedded dataTypeId/engUnitId by name on the target system
	dataTypes = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getDataTypes({})) if records else []
	engUnits = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getUnits({})) if records else []
	pickLists = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.quality.config.getPickList({})) if records else []
	
	# dict-shaped payload (not a bare list) so the shared importer popup's
	# dict(data)/except heuristic doesn't misparse our 2-key records
	return {'data': {'procedures': records, 'dataTypes': dataTypes, 'engUnits': engUnits, 'pickLists': pickLists} if records else None, 'label': label}

system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection() message rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if payload.has_key('msgHandler') and payload['msgHandler'] == 'procedureSelected': 	self.procedureSelected(payload)

	system.perspective.print("updatePopupSelection complete")
	
	return

# implement your handler here
	system.perspective.print('procedureDropped() called with payload: %s'%payload)

#	system.perspective.print("assetDropped() msg rcvd with draggedItem %s | droppedItem %s"%(payload['draggedItem']['assetPath'], payload['droppedItem']['assetPath']))
	procedurePath = payload['draggedItem']['procedurePath']
	if procedurePath is None: return
	
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate:
		system.perspective.print("User action not allowed. sending refreshTreeSelector() msg")
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.procedures.data')		
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'User action not allowed'})
		return
			
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem'] if payload['droppedItem'] is not None else {'parentId': None, 'assetId': None, 'assetPath': 'root level'}

	system.perspective.print("draggedItem['procedureCategoryId'] - %sdraggedItem['procedureId'] - %s droppedItem['procedureCategoryId'] - %s"%(draggedItem['procedureCategoryId'], draggedItem['procedureId'], droppedItem['procedureCategoryId']))
	
	# First handle disallowed drag and drops
	if droppedItem['procedureId'] is not None:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', payload={'message': 'Cannot drop a procedure/procedure category onto a procedure.'})
	else:
		self.updateProcedureParent(draggedItem, droppedItem)
	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.procedures.data')
	return

system.perspective.print("confirmMoveProcedure() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	draggedItem = payload['inputPayload']['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['inputPayload']['droppedItem']
	
	if payload['userInput'] == 'OK':

		assetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.cmms.getAssets({'assetId': draggedItem['assetId']}),0)
		assetInfo['parentId'] = droppedItem['assetId'] if droppedItem is not None else None
		
		system.perspective.print("Moving %s to parentId %s"%(assetInfo['assetPath'],  assetInfo['parentId']))
		
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.updateAsset(assetInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Asset was not moved. %s'%msg})
		else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Asset has been moved'})
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTreeSelector", {'search': ''})

	self.selectAsset(None)
	self.view.custom.assets.refreshTree = True
	system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {})

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
	
	return
